biotools.summary: RbSP is a tool developed at EBI that integrates GWAS data with protein-protein interaction networks to prioritize proteins involved in blood pressure regulation. The workflow utilizes a Microsoft SQL Server database to store and analyze data from various sources and reconstruct protein interactomes.
